thread.title: UPDATE: Trump Today: President says Russia denies election meddling, as Putin meeting set in Helsinki

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Trump Today: President says Russia denies election meddling, as Putin meeting set in Helsinki
text:
By Robert Schroeder, MarketWatch
Trump attends Foxconn plant groundbreaking after touting project
President Donald Trump on Thursday cast doubt on Russian meddling in the U.S. presidential election as his Helsinki summit with Vladimir Putin was announced, and appeared at the groundbreaking ceremony for a Foxconn facility in Wisconsin.
TRUMP SKEPTICAL ON MEDDLING
As the White House announced Trump's July 16 meeting with the Russian leader, the president showed fresh skepticism about Moscow's seeking to interfere in the 2016 election. "Russia continues to say they had nothing to do with Meddling in our Election!" Trump said on Twitter.
U.S. intelligence agencies concluded in January 2017 that Russia did seek to influence the election in favor of Trump (https://www.cnn.com/2017/01/06/politics/intelligence-report-putin-election/index.html) over Democrat Hillary Clinton. On Wednesday, Trump's national security adviser John Bolton said Trump would likely raise the election-meddling issue with Putin. A statement by White House press secretary Sarah Sanders said only that the leaders "will discuss relations between the United States and Russia and a range of national security issues."
Trump also blasted Special Counsel Robert Mueller -- who is leading the probe into whether Trump's campaign colluded with Russia -- and Peter Strzok, an FBI agent who exchanged anti-Trump messages with bureau attorney Lisa Page in 2016. The president has consistently labeled the Mueller probe a "witch hunt."
Key Words:Trump's intelligence director lashes out at Putin even as his boss wants Russia back in G-7 (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/trumps-intelligence-director-lashes-out-at-putin-even-as-his-boss-wants-russia-back-in-g-7-2018-06-11).

FOXCONN CEREMONY
Trump spoke at the groundbreaking for Foxconn Technology Group's (2317.TW) new facility in Mount Pleasant, Wis., about a year after he announced the deal involving the Taiwanese supplier to Apple Inc. (AAPL).
The company is formally known as Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., and has promised to open a major complex to build liquid-crystal display panels. Calling the planned facility the "eighth wonder of the world," Trump said the company has discovered "there is no better place to build, hire and grow than right here in the United States."
Trump said 15,000 jobs will be created at the plant. The company itself has put that number at 13,000, however. The president also took a fresh shot at Harley-Davidson (HOG) over the iconic Wisconsin-headquartered motorcycle maker's plans to shift more production abroad. "Please build those beautiful motorcycles in the U.S.A.," Trump said. "Don't get cute with us."
Harley has said the move is due to increased costs from the European Union's retaliatory tariffs against the Trump administration's own tariffs on imported aluminum and steel.
